title: Inconsistent state-advance patterns across Store modules
description: Each Store module (contact, chat, message) handles state advancement differently: contact.rs defines both a private advance_state(conn) function AND a public method, creating confusing dual interface. message.rs cleanly separates advance_state_counter() (internal, returns i64) from advance_state() (public, returns String). The pattern (call advance_state after writes) is discoverable from existing code, but the inconsistency means a contributor landing in contact.rs might not replicate the pattern correctly. Suggestion: document the pattern in the comment for each module's advance_state method, and refactor contact.rs to follow message.rs's design (clear internal vs. public split).
